listing.name: WH Rogue Trader Portrait Pack V1.0
listing.summary: This mod adds over 40 portraits from the game Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader, playable characters, companions and some of the major characters, in addition to that there are also 3 portraits from the concept art of the game 40k Darktide.
listing.aiSummary: Adds over 40 portraits from Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader and 3 from Darktide concept art.

description: Adds over 40 portraits from Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader, including playable characters, companions, and major characters. It also includes 3 portraits from the concept art of Warhammer 40k: Darktide. All portraits are available for player use, while only human portraits appear in some vanilla factions.

discordPostHtml:
This mod adds over 40 portraits from the game Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader, playable characters, companions and some of the major characters, in addition to that there are also 3 portraits from the concept art of the game 40k Darktide.

All of the portraits are available for player use while only the human portraits will show up in some of the vanilla factions.

Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hYRSJaJoVT9doR3avWnRbioIZokA60eQ/view

Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=31352.0
